items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-11-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yes. My real name is Curtis D. Jerdy. Okay. [INTERVIEWEE] I just want to see that it was picking him up.

ctx.x: This was the first March of Dimes when Roosevelt was alive. It was the March of Dimes was set up in his honor because of his, his affliction and his polioids. And it was there with Lou Forbes. He was, we were at the Roseville Hotel then. And they had, on stage, they had a regular backdrop on it. And Lou Forbes was conducting, and then we got a normal applause hand after we were finished playing. And as we were getting off the stage for the next band, our show actor was coming on, it started a tremendous amount of…
Yes. My real name is Curtis D. Jerdy. Okay.
I just want to see that it was picking him up.
